comment: What each reference seed claims. The words are the relevance gate: a candidate survives when its URL, the caption the page gives the image, or the page title names one. acquire.mjs reads this; mark.py reads it. Reviewed data, not code.

motion-tracker.subject: M513-3 motion tracker sweep and contact blip
motion-tracker.moves: a radial sweep turns at a fixed period; the blip appears when the sweep passes it, and fades on a measured decay, not on a timer someone liked

magi.subject: MAGI system conference: three cores deliberating
magi.moves: three triangular nodes light in turn while they vote; the verdict arrives after the vote, never on load

insertion-sync.subject: insertion sync / entry plug depth countdown
insertion-sync.moves: a percentage climbs under measurement while warning hatching flashes; a hold is a hold, not a pause animation

rig.subject: RIG spine: suit integrity, stasis, kinesis
rig.moves: segments drain downward as integrity is spent; stasis slows the world it is drawn over, so the reference shows the world and the bar slowing together

spinner-console.subject: spinner console, analyzer and baseline readouts
spinner-console.moves: a baseline breathes with the subject; analysis lines resolve under a scanning pass rather than appearing complete

lumon.subject: Lumon macrodata refinement terminal and OS
lumon.moves: nothing moves until the operator moves; numbers settle as a choice is taken, and the idle state is genuinely idle

tron-disc.subject: identity disc, grid overlay, light-cycle readouts
tron-disc.moves: arc segments trace themselves as a thing travels; a stalled thing stays drawn instead of easing back to a resting place

hologlobe.subject: holographic table: rotating globe with plotted routes
hologlobe.moves: rotation is continuous and belongs to the model, not the frame; plotted arcs are drawn once and hold, they do not pulse

ship-hud.subject: cockpit HUD: compass tape, reticle states, target lock
ship-hud.moves: the tape rolls with the ship and stops dead when it does; lock is a discrete state change, not a breathing glow

fake-os-loaders.subject: fictional operating systems and the loaders, progress bars and boot screens they invent
fake-os-loaders.moves: each fake OS has its own progress idiom, and the animation is the whole content of the screen
